name: LABRI (Lead-Acid Battery Recycling Initiative)
summary: Advocates for regulation of used lead-acid battery recycling to cut the lead pollution it causes.

spending.source: https://web.archive.org/web/20251211084755/https://www.charityentrepreneurship.com/track-record-charities/labri (no published accounts: its UK company was incorporated in June 2026, first accounts due 2028. lines.label: Research and policy work on used lead-acid battery recycling (the Philippines; scoping in Malawi, Cambodia and other countries)
